Definition: a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael
BiblicalUsage: Yisrᵉʼêlîyth means a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael. In Leviticus 24:10 we read, "And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel..." It appears again in Leviticus 24:11: "And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the LORD, and cursed."
TheologicalSignificance: Yisre'eliyth is a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael, and I believe the God who counts hairs also counts words.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
